newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine state bank says 96 net up by 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine state bank says 96 net up by 22 pct.

text.p: State-owned Land Bank of the Philippines (LandBank) said on Tuesday it had posted a net income of 1.6 billion pesos in 1996, up 22 percent from 1.31 billion pesos in 1995.
LandBank president Jesli Lapus said in a statement that the growth was attained by expanding the bank's credit network and revamping its organisation.
"The higher net income enables LandBank to pursue developmental initiatives for small farmers and agrarian reform beneficiaries under the Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Programme," he said.
The net loan portfolio grew by 49 percent to 77.2 billion pesos in 1996, while total resources expanded by 25.3 percent to 133.9 billion pesos.
